ambiguities: The entry arch is covered by a pitched roof, but the front facade extends above it in a curve, acting as a parapet. Per the spec for 'A flat roof behind a parapet wall', I masked the vertical parapet wall itself and marked is_parapet=true so the extraction will score the upper boundary (the curved top edge) where lights would hang.
